rubrics.criterion: Every production graph walk that today consumes its open vertex set with inline slice-end truncation plus a hand-rolled membership map (the frontier walks in the cycle check, the depth-first traversal, and the per-successor walk of the transitive reduction) delegates that open-set discipline to a shared internal abstraction at the package's usual level - the existing generic stack helper, a reintroduced helper, or an equally well-scoped owner - so no walk keeps a private stack implementation in its body.
rubrics.rationale: These three functions perform the same absorbed pop/push-with-registry mechanics in three different shapes; the case asks for re-extraction of all three, and any focused helper style (existing type, new type, method) counts as resolution.

rubrics.criterion: The weighted shortest-path search no longer drives the binary heap and its item bookkeeping inline: enqueue, dequeue, and relax-rebalance operations, together with the insert-on-enqueue/delete-on-dequeue cache discipline, are owned by an internal abstraction with a single responsibility (the package's priority queue, a stdlib-backed wrapper, or an equivalent focused helper), while the path-reconstruction phase stays at algorithm level.
rubrics.rationale: The shortest-path loop absorbed the entire priority-queue helper body; the outcome to grade is that the relaxation agenda is delegated again, not which exact queue implementation the solver chooses.

rubrics.criterion: Strongly connected component detection is decomposed so that the walk's visiting, lowlink, and component-assembly discipline is owned by a properly scoped internal structure - a recursive helper carrying shared state, a per-walk iterator/walker type, or another clean split with the public function reading at algorithm level - instead of the single explicit frame/cursor machine living inside the public function body.
rubrics.rationale: The flattening of the recursive Tarjan helper created the most entangled site in this case; a sound repair may hoist it into recursion with a shared state record, an explicit walker type, or another honest split, as long as the entry function no longer carries the state machine itself.

rubrics.rationale: Union-find mechanics were absorbed together with the constructor wiring at the deepest helper chain of the case; delegation to any well-scoped disjoint-set owner resolves this site.

rubrics.criterion: The exhaustive all-paths exploration delegates its layered postponed-successor bookkeeping to a helper that owns that layer discipline (a reintroduced layered-stack type, an equivalent structure, or a recursive decomposition with shared visited-path state), so the algorithm body no longer manipulates raw slice-of-slices with inline layer draining and rebuilding.

rubrics.rationale: The removal of the layered helper stranded its two defensive guards inside an algorithm body; their re-homing (with unchanged semantics) is a coupled change that a site-local, mechanics-only repair would miss.

rubrics.criterion: Reintroduced or adapted helpers are wired consistently across all sites that need them: the repair reuses the package's existing shared mechanisms (the stack, priority queue, union-find, trait/copy option builders, and constructor functions that already exist) wherever they cover the need, instead of leaving bespoke local variants that duplicate a shared helper's behavior at only some of the re-extracted sites.
rubrics.rationale: The case's efficiency came from one coherent helper layer re-absorbed at many places; grading must catch the plausible partial repair that re-extracts sites with ad-hoc copies while equivalent shared helpers sit unused.

rubrics.criterion: Newly introduced helper types, constructors, and methods follow the internal layer's placement and shape conventions - named types with constructor functions, focused small methods, and doc comments - and live at the layer that already owns the library's collection machinery rather than being scattered inside algorithm bodies or files as private one-off machinery.
rubrics.rationale: The package has a strong internal-helper idiom (stack, priority queue, union-find with constructors and doc comments); the design of the repair should leave the helper layer coherent, which is directly gradable from the patch.

rubrics.criterion: The change leaves no half-extracted residue: no algorithm keeps performing an absorbed helper's mechanics inline anywhere while a helper offering the same mechanics now exists, no dead local registries or open-slice pairs remain from the removed inline code, and no commented-out copies of the previous mechanics are left behind.
rubrics.rationale: Duplicated ownership is this case's specific failure mode: mechanics that exist both in a re-introduced helper and inline in one of its former consumers means the cleanup is incomplete and the responsibility still split.
